Exact finite computations through size 11 and independent literal relational-composition enumeration plus orbit canonicalization through n=6 corroborate. Finite checks are not treated as the proof.

value.rationale: Exact unlabeled isomorphism-class counts are intrinsic invariants of the entire natural class of finite two-agent commuting S5 frames. They differ substantively from known labelled counts and detect relabeling automorphisms. The connected and arbitrary-frame generating functions give a reusable complete-size census rather than an arbitrary low-order table; the logical class has explicit motivation in source literature.
